description.en:
Sets the sell price of any fillType (base game, map or mods) from one editable XML table.
Prices are the HARD difficulty in-game price per 1000 L. The mod only applies them on HARD economic difficulty unless configured otherwise.
- Table: modSettings/FS25_SellPrices/prices.xml (created on first start) - Optional seasonal factor curves and per-selling-point priceScale overrides - Buying prices of changed fillTypes stay at the original value - Saved price history and price fluctuation curves are rescaled to the new prices - Console: spDump writes all prices and selling points to priceDump.csv, spReload applies an edited table live
